question.text: Nomination in a demat account is a provision under which Act?

explanation.text: The Logic: In the demat (depository) context, the nomination facility for shares is governed under the Depositories Act, 1996. Demat account holders can nominate up to 10 persons under the depository segment. The Trap: The Companies Act, 2013 also provides for nomination of shares and debentures, but the workbook review answer for the demat nomination context identifies the Depositories Act, 1996. Note: The Series VI workbook review question (p.128) identifies the Depositories Act, 1996 as the answer for this question; p.118 describes the Companies Act, 2013 nomination provision for shares and debentures and the up-to-10 nominee facility for demat holders.
